ambient_events: The air over the Rad Sink shimmers and warps the ruin behind it into something molten.
Your counter, if you carry one, stops ticking and simply screams a single unbroken note.
description: The lowest point of the Redline, where every poison the frontier produces drains and pools and concentrates into a sump so hot the air above it shimmers. Nothing lives in the Rad Sink. Things merely pass through it, and are lessened.
name: The Rad Sink
